variants.headline: Looking back: home world sends punitive expedition
variants.sub: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The home world had sent a punitive expedition.

Dispatch of an expedition is not a complete account of conditions in the colony. Commercial readers should resist translating it automatically into a forecast of interruptions or losses. A careful judgment separates the known political action from assumptions about timing, physical effects and the terms of any eventual encounter.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The conduct of {target} warrants scrutiny in relation to the dispatch. This newspaper does not treat the expedition's purpose as evidence of an unreported encounter or an established outcome in the colony.

variants.headline: Looking back: an expedition with a punitive purpose
variants.sub: The home world has dispatched an expedition intended to punish the colony.
variants.body:
Looking back to {first_reported}, this was the news: A punitive expedition had been dispatched by the home world.

Dispatch of an expedition is not a complete account of conditions in the colony. Commercial readers should resist translating it automatically into a forecast of interruptions or losses. A careful judgment separates the known political action from assumptions about timing, physical effects and the terms of any eventual encounter.

Time changes the distance from an event, not the need to judge it carefully. Any claim about improvement or deterioration needs more than a recollection of the original news.

The conduct of {target} warrants scrutiny in relation to the dispatch. This newspaper does not treat the expedition's purpose as evidence of an unreported encounter or an established outcome in the colony.

variants.headline: Looking back: distant authority dispatches an expedition
variants.sub: The home world has sent a punitive expedition.
variants.body:
The headline belongs to {first_reported}. Our original account recorded this: The home world had dispatched an expedition intended to punish the colony.

Dispatch of an expedition is not a complete account of conditions in the colony. Commercial readers should resist translating it automatically into a forecast of interruptions or losses. A careful judgment separates the known political action from assumptions about timing, physical effects and the terms of any eventual encounter.

What has changed since then should be examined against that original record. What has not changed is the need to distinguish an established event from the hopes or fears attached to it.

The conduct of {target} warrants scrutiny in relation to the dispatch. This newspaper does not treat the expedition's purpose as evidence of an unreported encounter or an established outcome in the colony.
